summary: Tested PATCH /api/users/{user_id}/compensation role normalization fix (lowercase + strip + auto-correct DB). All 19 backend tests passed (100%): 4 non-canonical role variants (Dirigente, DIRIGENTE, '  dirigente  ', Coach) accepted with 200 and DB auto-normalized to canonical lowercase; invalid role 'pippo' rejected with 400 and diagnostic message containing actual role; canonical roles (coach/dirigente/collaboratore/athlete) still 200 with no spurious DB writes; admin/parent still rejected with 400. Backend logs confirm 'role normalizzato da X a Y' INFO messages fired correctly. The original VERDI FABIO bug scenario is fully covered.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py L4970: `str(raw_role).strip().lower() if raw_role else ''` is fine but the `if raw_role` short-circuit on falsy is redundant since `str(None).strip().lower()` would yield 'none' (different but harmless). Consider simplifying to `str(raw_role or '').strip().lower()`.

server.py L4978: comparison `normalized_role != raw_role` triggers DB write also when raw_role is None (since '' != None). Minor; auto-correction will set role='' for users with null role and then fail allow-list check — but order of operations means allow-list check happens BEFORE the correction, so this is safe.
Auto-correction log is INFO level — good for traceability of historical case-mismatch fixes; consider adding a Mongo migration script to bulk-normalize roles offline as a permanent fix.

rca of the issue: Originale (VERDI FABIO): admin riceveva 400 'Compenso applicabile solo a coach, dirigenti e collaboratori' anche se l'utente era dirigente. Root cause: il valore di `user.role` in db.users non era nella forma canonica lowercase (es. 'Dirigente' o 'DIRIGENTE' o con whitespace), mentre l'allow-list confrontava case-sensitive contro 'coach'/'dirigente'/etc. Mitigation applicata in server.py L4966-4980: `normalized_role = str(raw_role).strip().lower()` + confronto allow-list su versione normalizzata + auto-aggiornamento di db.users con il valore corretto quando differente dal raw (log INFO). I test coprono tutti gli scenari richiesti (Capital, UPPER, whitespace, invalid, canonical regression).
